content:
I really wanted to like this foam mattress, but it was a major disappointment.  
It felt comfortable for the first night, then quickly became too soft and unsupportive.  
After only a couple of weeks, it started sagging in the middle.  
The edges are weak, so sitting or sleeping near the side feels unstable.  
It also arrived with a strong chemical smell that took several days to fade.  
I woke up with more back pain than I had with my old mattress.  
For the price, I expected much better quality and durability.  
I would not recommend this mattress unless you prefer very soft, unsupportive foam.
